name: WebNIC SSL
description: REST routes a client can drive for a WebNIC SSL certificate service: read-only status, supported validation methods and issued-certificate download

category.name: WebNIC SSL
category.description: WebNIC SSL certificates resold through this installation

GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/status.name: Certificate Status
GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/status.description: Synchronize and return the certificate order status for the service

GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/dcv-methods.name: Supported DCV Methods
GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/dcv-methods.description: Domain Control Validation methods this certificate product supports

GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/certificate.name: Download Certificate
GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/certificate.description: The issued certificate (PEM chain) for the service, when available

GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/auth-info.name: Validation Details
GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/auth-info.description: Per-method domain-control-validation details (DNS records, HTTP file, email approvers) for the order

GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/dcv-status.name: DCV Status
GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/dcv-status.description: Current domain-control-validation status for the certificate order

POST /service/@id/webnic_ssl/change-dcv-.name: Change DCV Method
POST /service/@id/webnic_ssl/change-dcv-.description: Switch the order's domain-control-validation method (dns, file or email)

param.name: method
param.description: Target DCV method (dns, http/file or email)

param.name: email
param.description: Approver email (required when switching to email validation)

POST /service/@id/webnic_ssl/resend-appr.name: Resend Approver Email
POST /service/@id/webnic_ssl/resend-appr.description: Re-send the domain-control-validation approver email for every email-validated domain on the order

GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/csr.name: Decode CSR
GET /service/@id/webnic_ssl/csr.description: Decode the CSR stored on the service into its subject fields (common name, organization, SANs, hashes)

POST /service/@id/webnic_ssl/generate-cs.name: Generate CSR
POST /service/@id/webnic_ssl/generate-cs.description: Generate a CSR and private key server-side for the service (defaults to the service domain and stored organization details)

param.name: commonName
param.description: Common name (defaults to the service domain)

param.name: sanfield
param.description: Subject Alternative Names (defaults to the stored SAN list)
